originalTitle: AI investor Leopold Aschenbrenner forced to unwind all public stock positions after steep losses, sources say
summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund has sold all of its public stock holdings, according to people familiar with the matter.
content:
The battered hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner is unwinding many of its trades after big losses on artificial intelligence stocks and a bad bet against software stocks left it scrambling to raise cash, according to people familiar with the matter. The prime brokers for the fund, Situational Awareness , have been rushing to raise cash to meet margin requirements, the people said. Ken Griffin's Citadel hedge fund reached a deal to buy the fund's publicly traded assets, people familiar with the deal said. Situational Awareness has sustained significant losses in recent weeks as its portfolio of AI infrastructure investments such as SK Hynix declined while short positions in software companies such as Adobe moved sharply against it, the people said.

The fund grew to as big as $45 billion at the start of July before big losses took hold, according to a person familiar. Several of the firm's prime brokers — including Bank of America , Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase —have been working with the fund as it seeks to meet margin requirements or reduce positions in an orderly fashion, according to people familiar with the discussions. The brokers have been marketing a group of the firm's holding on both the long and short side for sale prior to Thursday's start of trading, according to people familiar with the situation.

The situation remains fluid. It couldn't be determined whether the firm was satisfying its margin calls through the sales. The firm had been negotiating to sell its stake in Anthropic but it wasn't clear if that deal was done. A spokesman for the firm said reports that it was marketing a stake it owns in Anthropic are not accurate.

The unwind comes at an unfortunate time for Aschenbrenner, who is getting married this weekend, two sources confirmed. Aschenbrenner is engaged to Avital Balwit, chief of staff for Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, according to an October profile in Fortune.

The turmoil is an early and potentially significant test of the investment thesis that made Aschenbrenner one of the most closely watched figures in the AI trade. The 25-year-old built the firm around the idea that increasingly powerful AI systems would require a vast expansion of chips, memory, data centers and electricity generation.

The fund's largest holdings at the end of the first quarter included Nebius Group , Sandisk , Micron and CoreWeave , according to filings. All four of those stocks are down more than 35% this month.

Aschenbrenner became prominent in technology and investing circles after publishing a series of essays in 2024 arguing that rapid advances in artificial intelligence would require an enormous expansion of computing power, advanced semiconductors, memory and energy infrastructure. Those ideas became the intellectual foundation for Situational Awareness after he left OpenAI.

Aschenbrenner graduated from Columbia University as valedictorian at the age of 19 before joining OpenAI's Superalignment team. He was fired in 2024 over what the company described as an improper disclosure of internal information. Aschenbrenner has disputed that characterization, saying he shared a largely nonconfidential planning document with outside researchers for feedback, and has said his dismissal followed tensions over warnings he raised about OpenAI's security practices. OpenAI has said those concerns were unrelated to his departure.

The investor also had a brief stint at a philanthropy-focused fund founded by FTX's Sam Bankman-Fried , according to Fortune.

The size of the fund's losses and the amount it was seeking to raise couldn't immediately be determined.
chineseTitle: 消息人士称，AI 投资者利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 在大幅亏损后被迫平仓所有公开股票头寸
chineseSummary: 据知情人士透露，利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 的对冲基金已出售其持有的所有公开股票。
chineseContent:
据知情人士透露，前 OpenAI 研究员利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 创立的这家饱受打击的对冲基金正在平仓，因为人工智能股票遭受巨额损失，而且做空软件股票的糟糕赌注导致该基金忙于筹集现金。知情人士称，该基金的主要经纪商 Situational Awareness 一直在急于筹集现金以满足保证金要求。知情人士称，肯·格里芬 (Ken Griffin) 的 Citadel 对冲基金已达成协议，购买该基金的公开交易资产。知情人士称，由于 SK 海力士等人工智能基础设施投资组合下降，而 Adob​​e 等软件公司的空头头寸大幅波动，Situational Awareness 最近几周遭受了重大损失。

据一位知情人士透露，该基金在 7 月初规模已增至 450 亿美元，随后出现了巨额亏损。据知情人士透露，该公司的几家主要经纪商——包括美国银行、高盛和摩根大通——一直在与该基金合作，以寻求满足保证金要求或有序减少头寸。据知情人士透露，在周四交易开始之前，经纪商一直在出售该公司持有的多头和空头股票。

局势仍然不稳定。无法确定该公司是否通过销售满足了追加保证金的要求。该公司一直在就出售其在 Anthropic 的股份进行谈判，但尚不清楚该交易是否已完成。该公司的一位发言人表示，有关其正在营销其所拥有的 Anthropic 股份的报道并不准确。

两位消息人士证实，对于本周末即将结婚的阿申布伦纳来说，这次放松来得不是时候。据《财富》10 月份的报道称，阿申布伦纳已与 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的幕僚长阿维塔尔·巴尔维特 (Avital Balwit) 订婚。

这场动荡是对投资论的早期且潜在的重大考验，正是这一论使阿申布伦纳成为人工智能行业最受关注的人物之一。这位 25 岁的年轻人创立公司的理念是，日益强大的人工智能系统需要大幅扩展芯片、内存、数据中心和发电能力。

文件显示，该基金第一季度末最大的持股包括 Nebius Group 、 Sandisk 、 Micron 和 CoreWeave 。这四只股票本月均下跌超过 35%。

阿申布伦纳 (Aschenbrenner) 在 2024 年发表了一系列文章，认为人工智能的快速发展需要计算能力、先进半导体、内存和能源基础设施的大幅扩展，随后在技术和投资界崭露头角。在他离开 OpenAI 后，这些想法成为了态势感知的知识基础。

Aschenbrenner 19 岁时作为告别演说者从哥伦比亚大学毕业，随后加入 OpenAI 的 Superalignment 团队。他于 2024 年因不当披露内部信息而被公司解雇。 Aschenbrenner 对这种描述提出了异议，称他与外部研究人员分享了一份基本上非机密的规划文件以寻求反馈，并表示他的解雇是在他对 OpenAI 安全实践提出警告而引发的紧张局势之后发生的。 OpenAI 表示，这些担忧与他的离职无关。

据《财富》杂志报道，这位投资者还曾在 FTX 的 Sam Bankman-Fried 创立的一家专注于慈善事业的基金中短暂任职。

该基金的损失规模及其寻求筹集的金额无法立即确定。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
